MenuItem.Name: Create Devices for Discovered Base Stations

Field.Label: Pre-filled with the networks your existing AirPort devices and this Mac are on. Separate several with commas, e.g. 10.0.9.0/24, 10.0.1.0/24. Finds base stations Bonjour can't see, including the AirPort Snow and Graphite, by checking every address. No password is used for the scan.
Create devices for new base stations:
New devices use the admin password set in the plugin configuration (if any) and go in the same folder as auto-created devices. Results are written to the event log.
